name: Wings of Silicon
source:
Two years ago, you came to Silicon Gorge, the world's hippest tech city, as a Graphic Designer. You had big plans and goals, but all those lies shattered now. These days, you keep your head above water with your own game project, but the work can be even more demanding than your last job. Luckily, one day, a cute and attractive girl comes to your door. You imagine she might be the missing piece of code to not only inspire you but so much more.

Of course, nothing in the Gorge is simple. You discover that she lives with her aunt, a beautiful and mature woman. Will you go for the charming college student? Or the amazing and driven executive? Then again, perhaps the temptations of the innovative capital of the world will lead you elsewhere. Only YOU can decide.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/sinappeal]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
两年前，你以平面设计师的身份来到Silicon Gorge——这座城市是全球最时髦的科技中心。你曾有远大的计划和目标，如今却发现一切都成了泡影。最近，你靠自己的游戏项目勉强维持生计，但这份工作甚至比上一份更繁重。幸运的是，有一天，一位可爱迷人的女孩来到你家门口。你想，她或许能为你带来灵感，甚至成为生活中更重要的部分。

当然，Gorge里的一切都没那么简单。你发现她和姑妈住在一起；她的姑妈是一位美丽成熟的女性。你会选择那位迷人的大学生，还是那位出色又干练的女主管？当然，世界创新之都的种种诱惑或许会引领你走向别处。只有你能做出决定。

[来源：[url=https://www.patreon.com/sinappeal]Patreon[/url]]
